column1: # Glow parity cases: one source for the C oracle, the native Omega runner and the wasm harness.
# frame NAME W H        new canvas, every pixel 0, clip = whole canvas; the previous frame is dumped
# clip X Y W H          clip rectangle in pixels (C ck_rect)
# grad                  fixture gradient inside clip and canvas (background.om)
# glow CX CY R RED GREEN BLUE A   ck_glow; CX CY R in 16ths of a pixel; colour CK_RGB(RED, GREEN, BLUE)
# Output: every frame's whole canvas, little-endian uint32 pixels, row-major, frames in order.
# Colours are copied from the pinned callers (adapter.c lines 174-175, mind.c lines 228-265).
